Shipped in one PR within the appetite; one checkpoint review and two QA rounds.

Brief · Cover sheet · Verification · Trace

  2. Checkpoint review of P-1 found F-1 (Must-Fix) and F-2 (Should-Fix).
  3. Both fixed at 5d27e80.

How implementation went

PackageReusedCreatedWhat worked
P-1Semantic tokens in tokens.cssTheme store, boot script, dark token blockSemantic tokens meant dark needed one block of values, not per-screen edits
P-2ButtonGroup, SettingsRowThemeControlKeyboard support came free with the button group

Contributing factors

  • How did the storage crash get past the first build? The tests ran in an environment where storage never throws, so the blocked case was never exercised.
  • How did the focus ring vanish in dark? The ring and the selected fill both used the accent token, and only light was checked while building.
  • How did labels wrap on phones? Segment widths were fixed in pixels, copied from the desktop mockup frame.

Surprises and deviations

OriginalActual
Storage reads are safeThey can throw in private windows; now guarded
One focus colour for both themesDark needs its own focus token

Unexpected issues

The focus ring disappeared in the dark theme because it reused a light-only colour token. Found by the verifier in QA round 1; screenshots in the verification page.

Critical decisions

Add a dark value for the focus token instead of a one-off override on the toggle, so every focusable control stays consistent. Taken by the implementer; no relay needed.

Assumptions that were wrong

None.

Thrashing

None. Each jank item was fixed once and passed in round 2.

Verification and review

J-1, J-2 and S-1 pass (verification). Review points: the P-1 checkpoint (F-1 and F-2, both fixed, see findings) and the end review (no findings). QA rounds: 2 of 3.
